projects.subtitle: Academic project briefs across core computer science subjects, with suggested timelines and learning goals.

noteCard.label: Study note
noteCard.title: Built around learning.
noteCard.text: These are suggested coursework briefs and timelines. Each can grow into a completed project as the related subjects are studied.

items.title: Visual Algorithm Explorer
items.description: Suggested data structures and algorithms project: model a campus map as a graph, implement traversal and shortest-path algorithms, and compare their time and space complexity.

items.title: Blood Management System
items.description: Suggested object-oriented programming project: design a system for managing blood inventory, donors, and recipients. Implement classes, encapsulation, and inheritance, and create UML diagrams to illustrate the design.

items.title: Student Project Database
items.description: Suggested database management project: design an ER model for students, projects, and enrollment, normalize the schema, then practice SQL queries, joins, constraints, and transactions.

items.title: Disease Detection chatbot
items.description: Suggested machine learning study: prepare a suitable dataset, explore relevant features, compare a baseline with classification or regression models, and report evaluation results and limitations.

items.title: System Analysis & Design
items.description: Suggested system analysis and design project: gather requirements for a research project, design the system architecture, and document the design with UML.

items.title: Computer Networks Project: University Routing Protocols
items.description: Suggested computer networks project: analyze and implement routing protocols for a university network, focusing on dynamic routing algorithms and network performance optimization.

items.title: Network Protocol Guide
items.description: Suggested computer networks project: illustrate how a browser request travels through DNS, TCP/IP, and HTTP, and explain the role of each protocol with concise diagrams.

items.title: Basic C/C++ Projects
items.description: Suggested C/C++ project: implement basic data structures and algorithms in C/C++, focusing on memory management and performance optimization.
